_: Scenar nahovoru EN (src/copy/vo.en.json), vyrobeny scripts/vo_lang_init.py z src/copy/vo.json. Casy `at` su slovenske (obraz sa nemeni); `sk` = povodna veta (len pre kontrolu). Kym je `_voice` false, `dur` a `partAt` su zastupne slovenske hodnoty a video sa renderuje bez hlasu. Hlas: node scripts/vo.mjs --engine gemini --script <tento subor> --dir public/<vo|vo-kratka>-en, potom `_voice: true`.
_style: calm, matter-of-fact corporate narrator; neutral, clear British English; fluent and connected, a bit brisker than a documentary narrator; only a short breath at commas, a longer pause only at the end of a sentence; no extra emotion. Pronunciation: the brand name Assetin is read as written, a-se-tin with a hard t; Archives as in English. Say QR as 'cue are'. Codes like PL_01, KR_01, ZL_03 are read as English letter names plus the plain number, without the underscore and the leading zero: 'P L one, K R one, Z L three'.

C2-Hladanie.text: When did you last struggle to find a document? A report, a drawing or a certificate?
parts: When did you last struggle to find a document?
A report, a drawing or a certificate?
C2-Hladanie.sk: Kedy ste naposledy nevedeli nájsť nejaký dokument? Či už správu, výkres alebo protokol?

C2-Hladanie.text: In storage, on a shelf, in a box or in a folder.
C2-Hladanie.sk: V sklade, na polici, v krabici alebo v zložke.

C4-Cena.text: Sometimes it is faster to have the documentation made again. So you may end up paying twice for the same thing.
parts: Sometimes it is faster to have the documentation made again.
So you may end up paying twice for the same thing.
C4-Cena.sk: Niekedy je rýchlejšie dať dokumentáciu vyhotoviť nanovo. A tak sa môže stať, že zaplatíte dvakrát za to isté.

C4-Cena.text: With us, you find it in seconds.
C4-Cena.sk: S nami ho nájdete za pár sekúnd.

C4-Cena.styleExtra: Warm, confident introduction, falling intonation at the end.

C4-Cena.text: We turn your archive into a clear digital catalogue.
C4-Cena.sk: Z vášho archívu urobíme prehľadný digitálny katalóg.

C4b-Hacik.text: Scanning an entire archive can be expensive.
C4b-Hacik.sk: Naskenovať celý archív môže byť drahé.
C4b-Hacik.styleExtra: Calm, matter-of-fact statement; a gentle emphasis on expensive; falling intonation at the end.

C4b-Hacik.text: Our app photographs only the title page.
C4b-Hacik.sk: Naša aplikácia fotí len identifikačnú stranu.

C5-Teren.text: The solution starts with the physical documents.
Every item, whether a shelf, a box, a binder or a folder, gets a QR code, matching how your archive is organised.
parts: Every item, whether a shelf, a box, a binder or a folder,
gets a QR code, matching how your archive is organised.
C5-Teren.sk: Každá položka, či už polica, krabica, šanón alebo zložka, dostane QR kód, podľa toho, ako máte archív usporiadaný.
C5-Teren.styleExtra: Pace for this sentence: calm and unhurried; a short clear pause after each item of the list and after QR code.

C5-Teren.text: An ordinary phone is all you need.
C5-Teren.styleExtra: Calm, clear, short statement in one breath; a gentle emphasis on ordinary; falling intonation at the end.

F1-Sken.text: On the phone, we choose the item type, for example a folder or a document, and place it in the hierarchy as it really is. Then we photograph its title page. This gives the item its own digital record.
parts: On the phone, we choose the item type,
for example a folder or a document,
and place it in the hierarchy as it really is.
Then we photograph its title page.
This gives the item its own digital record.
F1-Sken.sk: V mobile vyberieme typ položky, ako napríklad zložka alebo dokument, a zaradíme ju do hierarchie podľa skutočnosti. Potom odfotíme jej identifikačnú stranu. Položka tým dostane svoj digitálny záznam.

C7-Hierarchia.text: Every item has an exact place in the hierarchy, such as a shelf, a box, a folder or a document.
parts: Every item has an exact place in the hierarchy,
such as a shelf, a box, a folder or a document.
C7-Hierarchia.sk: Každá položka má presné miesto v hierarchii, ako napríklad polica, krabica, zložka alebo dokument.

C6-Spracovanie.text: The app then processes the photo.
C6-Spracovanie._note: Klip sa v dlhom videu nepouziva (C6 bez hlasu, C10 vypadol); bez generovania.

F2-Metadata.text: The app reads the text from the photo by itself and suggests the data it finds, for example the project name, the author or the year.
parts: The app reads the text from the photo by itself
and suggests the data it finds,
for example the project name, the author or the year.
F2-Metadata.sk: Aplikácia z fotky sama prečíta text a navrhne údaje, ktoré na nej nájde, napríklad názov projektu, autora alebo rok.

F4-Kontrola.text: But a suggestion is not a final record.
F4-Kontrola.sk: Návrh ale nie je finálny záznam.

F4-Kontrola.text: A person checks and confirms every value. The photo is the evidence and stays with the record.
parts: A person checks and confirms every value.
The photo is the evidence and stays with the record.
F4-Kontrola.sk: Človek každú hodnotu overí a potvrdí. Fotka je dôkaz a ostáva pri zázname.

F4-Kontrola.text: Any corrections or additions are made right in the suggestion.
F4-Kontrola.sk: Prípadné opravy a doplnenia prebiehajú priamo v návrhu.

F4-Kontrola.text: The result is a verified, traceable record of the physical document.
F4-Kontrola.sk: Tým vznikne overený a dohľadateľný záznam fyzického dokumentu.

C10-Databaza.text: The archive catalogue database can be exported, analysed or searched. The simplest way is search.
parts: The archive catalogue database can be exported, analysed or searched.
The simplest way is search.
C10-Databaza.sk: Vytvorenú databázu katalógu archívu vieme exportovať, analyzovať alebo prehľadávať. Najjednoduchšie je vyhľadávanie.
C10-Databaza._note: Klip sa v dlhom videu nepouziva (C6 bez hlasu, C10 vypadol); bez generovania.

F3-Vyhladavanie.text: Then just type a keyword. The app shows the path to the item and all the extracted data.
parts: Then just type a keyword.
The app shows the path to the item
and all the extracted data.
F3-Vyhladavanie.sk: Potom stačí napísať kľúčové slovo. Aplikácia ukáže cestu k položke aj všetky vyčítané údaje.

F3-Vyhladavanie.text: The keyword is highlighted in the record's metadata.
F3-Vyhladavanie.sk: Kľúčové slovo sa zvýrazní v metadátach záznamu.

C8a-Vysledok.text: The result: you know for certain which documents you have and exactly where they are.
parts: The result: you know for certain
which documents you have and exactly where they are.
C8a-Vysledok.sk: Výsledok: spoľahlivo viete, aké dokumenty máte a kde presne sa nachádzajú.

C8a-Vysledok.text: Then you can decide what to keep, what to shred and what to fully scan.
parts: Then you can decide
what to keep, what to shred
and what to fully scan.
C8a-Vysledok.sk: Potom viete rozhodnúť, čo uchovať, skartovať alebo plnohodnotne skenovať.

C8-Pilot.text: Either you catalogue it yourselves, or we process your archive for you, turnkey.
parts: Either you catalogue it yourselves,
or we process your archive for you, turnkey.
C8-Pilot.sk: Buď katalogizujete sami, alebo vám archív spracujeme na kľúč.

C8b-Technika.text: The app works in line with your security requirements, online with us or on your own infrastructure.
parts: The app works in line
with your security requirements,
online with us or on your own infrastructure.
C8b-Technika.sk: Aplikácia funguje v súlade s vašimi bezpečnostnými požiadavkami, online u nás alebo na vašej infraštruktúre.

C8c-Vyzva.text: Let's start with one box, free and with no obligation.
parts: Let's start with one box,
free and with no obligation.
C8c-Vyzva.sk: Začnime jednou krabicou, zadarmo a nezáväzne.
C8c-Vyzva.styleExtra: Tone for this sentence: warm, confident and inviting, a clear call to action.

C9-Outro._note: Nazov znie vo vsetkych jazykoch rovnako: slovenska nahravka.
